Asha/Evelyn — posting the raw numbers from the tuning sweep we ran today (attached: throughput_trace.csv). High-level summary below for seq len 512 (your primary workload):
- Hosted (baseline, m1024b): p50 = 22ms, p95 = 140ms, p99 = 270ms; sustained throughput ~ 2.6k tokens/sec under continuous 50 qps load.
- Dedicated (same model, smaller scheduling overhead): p50 = 18ms, p95 = 85ms, p99 = 150ms; throughput ~ 4.1k tokens/sec under same load.
- Notable: enabling prefix KV cache for repeated contexts cut p95 by ~30% on Hosted for warm requests.
- Batching: increasing batch window to 15ms improved throughput by ~18% but increased p95 by ~25ms on Hosted; Dedicated amortizes batch cost better.

Next tuning experiments I'm scheduling:
- Quantization profile test (int8 vs q4_0) to measure quality vs latency tradeoff (A/B runs) — due 2026-06-20.
- Kernel reorder: test alternative attention kernel for long sequences — due 2026-06-20.

Attachments: throughput_trace.csv (CSV tracing tokens/sec), latency_report_v3.pdf (summary charts).

Dev
